description: This file contains utility functions and wrappers for integrating Anthropic API streams, including handling headers, payload policies, service tiers, and fast modes, with functions to resolve parameters and compose stream wrappers.

methods.name: isAnthropic1MModel
methods.description: Checks if the given model ID starts with specific prefixes indicating a 1M context model.

methods.name: parseHeaderList
methods.description: Parses a comma-separated string into a list of trimmed strings.

methods.name: mergeAnthropicBetaHeader
methods.description: Merges existing headers with new beta values, ensuring no duplicates.

methods.name: isAnthropicOAuthApiKey
methods.description: Determines if an API key string indicates an OAuth key for Anthropic.

methods.name: resolveAnthropicFastServiceTier
methods.description: Returns the service tier ('auto' or 'standard_only') based on a boolean flag.

methods.name: normalizeFastMode
methods.description: Converts various raw inputs into a boolean indicating fast mode, or undefined.

methods.name: normalizeAnthropicServiceTier
methods.description: Normalizes a string input into a valid service tier or undefined.

methods.name: resolveAnthropicBetas
methods.description: Resolves beta strings based on extra parameters and model ID, including context1m logic.

methods.name: createAnthropicBetaHeadersWrapper
methods.description: Creates a stream wrapper that adds appropriate beta headers based on OAuth status and requested betas.

methods.name: createAnthropicFastModeWrapper
methods.description: Creates a stream wrapper that applies payload policies for fast mode.

methods.name: createAnthropicServiceTierWrapper
methods.description: Creates a stream wrapper that applies payload policies for specified service tier.

methods.name: resolveAnthropicFastMode
methods.description: Resolves the fast mode boolean from extra parameters.

methods.name: resolveAnthropicServiceTier
methods.description: Resolves the service tier from extra parameters, with warning on invalid values.

methods.name: wrapAnthropicProviderStream
methods.description: Composes stream wrappers based on resolved betas, service tier, and fast mode.
